text: First of all, Heather is such a kind hearted, genuine and kind person. This makes it so wonderful to work with her. During our initial consult call she walked through what our vision was for the painting. She was able to take our very vague and abstract vision and create a masterpiece from it. She let us know that we can be as creative as we want and it helped us figure out what to incorporate in our painting, including our sweet puppy! Heather brought our vision to life. Not only is the painting incredible, but she was incredible live on the wedding day as well! All of our wedding guests loved watching her paint throughout the evening and it was such good entertainment for everyone. We will treasure this painting for the rest of our lives!

owner_reply.text: Erica! Thank YOU so much for your kind words!!! It was wonderful working with you too!! You have such a joyful spirit and I can see why so many people adore you! I hope you enjoy your painting for years to come!💗
